mapper.select: SELECT guardian_id , user_id , guardian_name , guardian_phone , guardian_relation , guardian_priority , is_notify FROM guardians WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_notify = 1 ORDER BY guardian_priority, guardian_id
SELECT sos_id , user_id , lat , lng , checklist_json , send_msg , send_at FROM sos_events WHERE sos_id = #{sosId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sos_events SET send_at = NOW() WHERE sos_id = #{sosId} AND send_at IS NULL
UPDATE notifications SET status = 'SENT' , sent_at = NOW() WHERE sos_id = #{sosId} AND status = 'PENDING'
